reason: We only just got off E-Golf4U and the volunteers are exhausted; I can't go back to the board and ask for another switch, even a free pilot, within a year. The offer is fair, but the timing is wrong for us.
objection: Our older members will not install and use yet another app, and running a pilot alongside our current system means double work for volunteers who are already burned out. Two founders and no live club yet also make me nervous.
would_change_my_mind: Golfclub Zwolle live for a full season, with a board I can call who says older members actually use it and that Greenside did the migration work, not their volunteers. Then I'd bring it up when our current contract comes up for renewal.
